name: Wyrms

unlocks.name: Bigger and Badder
unlocks.notes: Allows Shadow Wyrm to spawn from Wyrms and Magma strykewyrm to spawn from Lava Strykewyrms while on task.

unlocks.name: Can of Wyrms
unlocks.notes: Extends Wyrm assignments from all eligible masters to 200-250.

variantInfo.name: Wyrm
notes: Standard Wyrms are level 97 draconic monsters requiring 62 Slayer.
They use melee and magic in direct melee range, but only magic when attacked from outside melee range.
They have flat armour 1, 120 Hitpoints, 50% earth weakness, and are vulnerable to dragonbane weapons.
They cannot be cannoned and require heat-protection boots in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.

variantInfo.name: Shadow Wyrm
notes: Superior slayer monster variant after purchasing Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points.
Can spawn from regular Wyrms, but cannot spawn from Wyrmlings.
Cannot be safespotted like regular Wyrms in the Slayer-only area.
Protect from Magic negates all damage while fighting it at range.

variantInfo.name: Wyrmling
notes: Lower-level Wyrms located in the Neypotzli Earthbound Cavern after partial Perilous Moons progress.
They only use melee, have half the Hitpoints and Defence of normal Wyrms, and can be cannoned.
They only drop Wyrmling bones, with Brimstone keys possible on Konar tasks.
Wyrmlings cannot spawn the Shadow Wyrm superior.

variantInfo.name: Lava strykewyrm
notes: Variant of Wyrms that can be killed on task after 60 Sailing access to Charred Island.
Uses melee and ranged; it uses only ranged when attacked from distance, so Protect from Missiles is used at range.
Cannot be cannoned and has a separate drop table from regular Wyrms.
Dragon metal sheet is four times more common while on a Wyrm task.

variantInfo.name: Magma strykewyrm
notes: Superior slayer monster variant after purchasing Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points.
Can spawn from Lava Strykewyrms while on a Wyrm task.
Can burrow and target the player's location, dealing 20+ damage if the player does not move away in time.
Can be safespotted by outranging its attacks; when safespotted it will not use the burrow special attack.

locationComparison.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon contains 16 Wyrms.
Seven of the Wyrms are in a task-only area south of the main batch of nine Wyrms.
Wyrms may be safespotted with Ranged in the task-only area.
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are required unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.

locationComparison.name: Neypotzli
notes: Neypotzli Earthbound Cavern contains 6 Wyrmlings.
The cluster of six Wyrmlings is close together and can be cannoned.
Free cooked bream, cooked moss lizards, and moonlight potions can be made inside.
Only drops Wyrmling bones.

locationComparison.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Charred Dungeon contains 12 Lava Strykewyrms.
The Charred Dungeon is multicombat and cannonable except for the sections with Lava Strykewyrms.
Lava Strykewyrms can be safespotted but require a weapon with 9 or 10 attack range.
Requires 60 Sailing access to Charred Island and deploying a rope to enter the dungeon.

taskNotes: Wyrms require 62 Slayer and are draconic creatures, so dragonbane weapons work on them.
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots must be worn in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary has been completed.
Attacking standard Wyrms outside of direct melee range causes them to only use Magic, so Protect from Magic negates all of their damage.
Standard Wyrms have flat armour value 1, but this is not a major concern due to their low stats.
Most Wyrms can be outranged by safespotting.
Wyrms have a 50% elemental weakness to earth spells.
Wyrmlings in Neypotzli are an alternative for players who do not want to kill normal Wyrms; they can be cannoned and free supplies can be made inside.
Wyrmlings cannot spawn the Shadow Wyrm and only drop Wyrmling bones.
Lava Strykewyrms require 60 Sailing, use Ranged rather than Magic at distance, and require Protect from Missiles when fought from range.
Lava Strykewyrms cannot be cannoned and use a different drop table from normal Wyrms.
The dragon metal sheet drop from Lava Strykewyrms is 4x more common on a Wyrm task.
Players killing Lava Strykewyrms long term benefit from a Charred Island bank chest at 70 Construction and a boat docked with a Greater teleport focus.
Lava Strykewyrms have a 50% elemental weakness to water spells.
Magma strykewyrm is the Lava Strykewyrm superior and can burrow to the player's location for 20+ damage if the player does not move.
recommendedMethod: Use the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon task-only area with Ranged or Magic safespotting and Protect from Magic for standard Wyrms, wearing heat-protection boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete. Melee with dragonbane weapons is also viable. Wyrmlings are a low-effort cannon alternative in Neypotzli, while Lava Strykewyrms are a 60 Sailing alternative with Protect from Missiles at range, water-spell weakness, dragon metal sheet value, and Magma strykewyrm superior spawns.
